review.assessment: The change introduces solution.mjs with a straightforward dot-path traversal and an undefined fallback, but stops short of guarding property access during iteration. As a result, the function still throws on any intermediate null or undefined value, failing to satisfy the requirement that missing or nullable intermediates return the default gracefully.

findings.actual: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'b')
findings.defect: Intermediate null/undefined values cause a TypeError before the fallback check can run.
